title: World Cup 2026: FIFA under fire for ticket prices
summary: As ⁠World ⁠Cup ticket prices continue to ⁠be debated, FIFA ​president Gianni Infantino declared they are in line with most American sporting events. FIFA has come under fire for ​the cost of tickets to the quadrennial tournament that starts June 11 in the United States, Mexico and Canada, but Infantino said market rates have to be applied.
